title: Mechanism: does the post-gate innovation reach the price?

design.innovation: proxy_scaled(post-gate) - proxy_scaled(pre-gate) per slot, standardised; both proxies are the cross-fitted physical predictions of phase89
design.inference: OLS with cluster-robust SE on area x delivery day

gate56_mechanism.reading: the innovation explains both residuals: the divergence is not about price formation and the expectations reading is withdrawn
gate56_mechanism.wording_rule: no branch licenses 'identifies' or 'locates the expectations channel'; the permitted phrasing is 'target divergence, consistent with'

implied_price_value.panel: the slots where both a physical and a price residual exist: daylight hours in the eight areas with published PV actuals, which is a HARDER sub-panel than the full ladder -- see implied_price_value_full_panel for the like-for-like figure
implied_price_value.reading: an in-sample ceiling on what a linear use of the excluded run's innovation could take off the pooled MAE. Compare it with the equivalence margin (0.01) and with the gate-timing delta the ladder measures: the ceiling is about one tick, and the learner realises a fraction of it

implied_price_value_full_panel.panel: every slot the ladder scores, nine areas. The sub-panel's own slope is applied where the innovation exists and nowhere else
implied_price_value_full_panel.reading: the like-for-like ceiling: compare THIS with the equivalence margin and with the gate-timing delta, both full-panel. The sub-panel figure is larger because the sub-panel is harder and because the innovation is zero on three quarters of the ladder's slots by construction

realised_vs_ceiling.reading: both the ceiling and what the design realises sit inside the equivalence margin, which is why the pooled test reports equivalence. The gap between them bounds how much a better encoding of this information could add
